violation_type.title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))
violation_type.short_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center
violation_type.typical_finding: The school-age summer program did not have a current activity schedule available.

finding_variants.text: The school-age summer program did not have a current activity schedule available.
All of the classrooms did not have the activity plan posted.
The operation did not had required posting activity plan posted on each age appropriate classroom during the application inspection.
The school age classroom did not have an activity plan posted.
There were no activity plans posted in the infant rooms or one toddler room during the inspection.
